params.name: ADC_CR1_JAWDEN
params.descEn: ADC analog watchdog 1 enable on scope ADC group injected

params.name: ADC_CR1_AWDEN
params.descEn: ADC analog watchdog 1 enable on scope ADC group regular

functions.briefEn: ADC analog watchdog 1 monitored channel selection
functions.exampleCode:
uint32_t v = ADC1->CR1;  /* 读回当前值 */
v &= ~ADC_CR1_AWDCH_Msk;  /* 先清掉 ADC_CR1_AWDCH：bits[4:0]（整个位域） */
v |= (1u << ADC_CR1_AWDCH_Pos) & ADC_CR1_AWDCH_Msk;  /* 置位，实际取值看参考手册 */
ADC1->CR1 = v;  /* 写回 */
